title: Engineering Associate
description:
**Job Description**

* Support senior engineers in the design, development, and implementation of engineering solutions and technical projects
* Assist in creating and maintaining comprehensive technical documentation, including design specifications, process flows, and system diagrams
* Conduct testing, troubleshooting, and quality assurance activities to identify and resolve technical issues
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, provide technical insights, and contribute to project planning and execution
* Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to ensure code quality and adherence to best practices
* Develop and maintain technical solutions while ensuring compliance with company standards and industry regulations
* Support the troubleshooting and resolution of technical problems reported by clients or internal stakeholders
* Contribute to process improvement initiatives by identifying inefficiencies and recommending enhancements
* Maintain and update existing systems, applications, and infrastructure to ensure optimal performance and reliability
* Participate in knowledge-sharing sessions and stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
* 1-3 years of professional experience in engineering, software development, or a related technical role
* Strong proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Java, C++, or JavaScript)
* Solid understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and engineering best practices
* Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and collaborative development workflows
* Ability to read, write, and review technical documentation and code
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams

title: Quality Coordinator
description:
WE ARE HIRING | Quality & Marketing Coordinator |
  
**BRAMOSH GLOBAL INSTITUTE (OPC) & Amsterdam HSE International**

**Permanent Employment | Remote Work | International Exposure**

**Greetings of the day from BRAMOSH GLOBAL INSTITUTE**
, a professional online education and training institute and strategic partner of 
**Amsterdam HSE International Academy (AHIA), Netherlands**
.

We collaborate with internationally recognised awarding and certification bodies to deliver professional qualifications and training programmes in 
**Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Sustainability, ISO Management Systems, and Business Leadership**
.

Our programmes range from 
**Level 2 to Level 7 Diplomas, MBA, DBA, and ISO Lead Auditor & Lead Implementer Certifications**
.

With a growing international presence, we have successfully trained 
**6,000+ professionals across 50+ countries**
.

As part of our continued expansion, we are inviting applications from talented, motivated, and creative professionals for 
**TWO JOB OPENINGS**
.

POSITION 1: QUALITY COORDINATOR

**Key Responsibilities:**

**◆ Maintain and update learner registration records, training documentation, and quality assurance files.**

**◆ Coordinate with trainers, learners, assessors, and management regarding course delivery, assessments, and learner progress.**

**◆ Monitor online training sessions, attendance, assignments, feedback, and learner satisfaction.**

**◆ Assist with internal quality assurance, compliance documentation, certification tracking, and awarding-body requirements.**

**◆ Prepare professional reports, Excel trackers, meeting records, and training schedules.**

**◆ Respond professionally to learner inquiries through email, WhatsApp Business, and other official communication platforms.**

POSITION 2: DIGITAL MARKETING & CONTENT EXECUTIVE
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

**◆ Design professional course posters, promotional brochures, presentations, and marketing materials using Canva and AI tools**
.

◆ Create engaging short-form videos, Instagram Reels, LinkedIn content, and promotional videos for our international training programmes.

◆ Manage and promote our courses through 
**LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp Business, and other digital platforms**
.

◆ Use 
**ChatGPT and other AI-powered tools**
 for content writing, creative marketing, video scripts, and campaign development.

◆ Generate prospective learner inquiries, follow up with interested candidates, and support the admissions team in achieving enrolment targets.

◆ Plan digital marketing campaigns, monitor engagement, maintain lead records, and submit regular performance reports.

ELIGIBILITY & ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS

✦ Strong written and verbal communication skills in 
**English**
.

✦ Proficiency in MS Office, Google Workspace, online communication platforms, and digital documentation.

✦ Working knowledge of 
**Canva, ChatGPT, and AI-based productivity tools**
. Video editing and social media marketing skills are particularly important for the marketing position.

✦ Candidates must be 
**energetic, self-motivated, disciplined, creative, flexible, and results-oriented**
.

✦ Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, handle responsibilities, and coordinate with an international team.

✦ Previous experience in educational administration, quality coordination, digital marketing, or online training will be an advantage.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

◆ Own laptop with a minimum 
**Intel Core i5 processor or equivalent**
.

◆ Reliable, high-speed internet connection.

◆ Own smartphone suitable for official communication and business-related activities.

◆ Quiet and professional work-from-home environment.

EMPLOYMENT BENEFITS

**Job Type:**
 Full-Time | Permanent

**Work Mode:**
 100% Remote / Work From Home

**Working Hours:**
 9 hours daily, including a 1-hour lunch break (8 working hours).

**Monthly Salary:**
 USD 180–220, depending on qualifications, skills, and interview performance.

**Additional Benefits:**
 Unlimited performance-based incentive earning opportunities, subject to achievement and company incentive policies.

**Career Opportunities:**
 International professional exposure, skill development, and opportunities for career growth.

**Important:**
 This is a full-time position. Selected candidates must dedicate their scheduled working hours exclusively to Bramosh Global and must not undertake simultaneous employment or freelance work during those hours.

LOCATION PREFERENCE

**Kolkata, West Bengal, India — Preferred**

**However, eligible candidates from other cities in India and other countries are also welcome to apply**
, subject to employment eligibility and operational requirements.

HOW TO APPLY

Interested candidates are requested to send their 
**updated CV/Resume**
 to:

**Email:**
 admin@bramoshglobal.com must be professional cv

**Email Subject:**
 Application for Quality Coordinator / Digital Marketing & Content Executive

Please clearly mention the position you are applying for.

Our HR and Administration Team will review the applications and contact shortlisted candidates to schedule an online interview.

We are looking for professionals who are passionate about learning, innovation, quality education, and international career development.

**Join BRAMOSH GLOBAL and grow with an internationally connected education and training organisation.**

**BRAMOSH GLOBAL INSTITUTE (OPC) PVT. LTD.**

* *Strategic Partner: Amsterdam HSE International Academy, Netherlands*

title: EY-GDS Consulting-AI And DATA-Healthcare-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Description: Senior Healthcare Interoperability Specialist**
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a skilled and experienced Healthcare Interoperability Specialist with 4-6 years of experience in the healthcare technology domain, especially in healthcare interoperability, clinical data modelling, data transformation, and integration workflows.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with HL7 FHIR, openEHR, and HL7 v2 standards, along with practical experience in openEHR template/archetype design, healthcare data mapping, terminology mapping, and interface validation.
  
  
This role requires someone who can contribute not only as an individual contributor but also support solutioning, technical design, team guidance, and stakeholder discussions. The candidate should be able to work closely with cross-functional teams to design, implement, validate, and improve scalable healthcare interoperability solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and contribute to the design, development, and implementation of healthcare interoperability solutions and platforms.
* Work with HL7 FHIR, openEHR, and HL7 v2 standards to design and implement healthcare data exchange workflows.
* Design, review, and maintain openEHR templates, archetypes, and clinical data models based on clinical and business requirements.
* Perform healthcare data mapping, transformation, and validation across different standards and source systems.
* Support terminology and concept mapping activities, including mapping of clinical concepts, codes, and value sets.
* Conduct interface testing, API testing, payload validation, and compliance checks against agreed specifications and standards.
* Participate in and drive solutioning, technical design, and architecture discussions for interoperability use cases.
* Help define data flow, transformation logic, integration approach, and validation strategy for healthcare interfaces.
* Collaborate with technical teams, business teams, clinical stakeholders, and external partners to clarify requirements and ensure correct implementation.
* Lead, guide, and mentor team members on interoperability standards, mapping logic, template design, and implementation approach.
* Review deliverables to ensure quality, consistency, accuracy, and alignment with healthcare interoperability standards.
* Track and report project progress, risks, dependencies, blockers, and outcomes to stakeholders and leadership.
* Stay updated with evolving healthcare interoperability standards, implementation guides, and industry best practices.

**Qualifications**

* 3-5 years of experience in the healthcare IT domain, with a strong focus on healthcare interoperability.
* Hands-on experience with HL7 FHIR, openEHR, and HL7 v2 standards.
* Strong experience in healthcare data modelling, data transformation, mappings, and integration workflows.
* Practical experience in designing and maintaining openEHR templates and archetypes.
* Experience in mapping healthcare data between different formats, systems, and standards.
* Experience in testing and validating healthcare interfaces, APIs, messages, and payloads.
* Experience in participating in or driving technical solutioning, design discussions, and implementation planning.
* Experience in guiding team members and reviewing technical deliverables.
* Familiarity with databases such as SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar relational databases.
* Basic programming or scripting knowledge is preferred; Java knowledge is an added advantage.
* Educational background in Information Technology, Computer Science, Healthcare Informatics, or a related field.

**Skills And Competencies**

* Strong understanding of healthcare interoperability standards and clinical data exchange.
* Good understanding of openEHR modelling, template design, archetypes, and clinical data structures.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to understand clinical/business requirements and translate them into technical designs and mappings.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work with cross-functional and distributed teams.
* Ability to guide team members and provide technical direction.
* Detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality, correctness, and compliance.
* Good documentation, reporting, and presentation skills.
* Ability to identify risks, dependencies, and gaps in requirements or implementation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Information Technology, Healthcare Informatics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Certification in HL7 v2, HL7 FHIR, openEHR, or healthcare interoperability standards is good to have but not mandatory.
* Experience with integration engines or healthcare integration tools such as Mirth Connect, NiFi, or similar tools is an added advantage.
* Experience with healthcare terminology standards such as SNOMED CT, LOINC, ICD, or concept/value set mapping is an added advantage.
* Experience working on CDR, EHR, EMR, data integration, or healthcare data platform implementations is preferred.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technology Consulting**
**Title: Application Engineer - III**
EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
  
  
Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology**
supports our technology needs through three business units:
  
  
**Client Technology (CT) -**
focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
  
  
**Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) –**
EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
  
  
**Information Security (Info Sec) -**
Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.
  
  
**The opportunity**
This role provides advanced-level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases under general direction, and leads front-end and back-end technologies, ensuring the functionality and user experience of the web solutions. The role requires a very strong understanding of front-end frameworks and back-end logic integration, optimization, data integration, documentation, and secure, scalable architecture aligned with enterprise standards.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provides senior level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases. Integrates third party products.
* Translates technical specifications into code for complex new or enhancement projects for internal clients. Writes programs, develops code, tests artifacts, and produces reports. Employs software development techniques to ensure tests are implemented in a way that support automation.
* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.
* Elevates code into the development, test, and production environments on schedule. Provides follow up production support. Submits change control requests and documents.
* Thoroughly understands software development methodology. Thoroughly understands development architecture standards. Trains and mentors staff with less experience. Resolves elevated issues.
* Participates in design, code, and test inspections throughout the life cycle to identify issues. Explains technical considerations at related meetings, including those with internal clients. Performs systems analysis activities.
* Thoroughly understands client business functions and technology needs. Has a broad understanding of Vanguard's technologies, tools, and applications, including those that interface with business area and systems.
* Interfaces with cross functional team members, and communicates systems issues at the appropriate technical level for each audience.
* Thoroughly understands and complies with Information Technology and Information Security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders
* Must Have skills: AWS Frontend leaning Full stack development with Java, Spring boot Microservices, API Integrations experience required.
* Typescript, React JS

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, system integration, database design, and back-end architecture.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Computer Science.
* Expertise in server-side development, system integration, and API management; strong knowledge of database design, optimization, debugging, and performance tuning.
* Must-have skills: Angular (V18 & above), Angular Material, Angular JS, Typescript, React JS, Java, Spring Boot, Node JS, AWS, CloudFormation, ECS, Fargate, DynamoDB, S3, Lambda, IAM, SQL queries, GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, CI/CD, TDD/BDD, Splunk, Honeycomb, Python.
* Knowledge of Agile, Confluence, JIRA; aptitude for continuous process improvement for process flows/workflows.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.
* Experience with AWS EC2 for compute provisioning and management.
* Experience with AWS SQS for queue-based messaging and asynchronous processing.
* Demonstrates proficiency in JavaScript.
* Possesses hands-on experience working with GitHub Actions.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)

**What We Look For**

* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.

**What Working At EY Offers**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

Core Banking, Retail Banking, and Consumer Lending

Hybrid

Kolkata, Pune, Chennai, or Bengaluru, in order of priority

We are looking for Senior Product / Functional Analysts with strong hands-on experience in Temenos Transact T24, particularly Arrangement Architecture and Loan Management and Servicing (LMS).

* Exposure to Arrangement Architecture.

* Experience in retail banking and consumer lending.
* Hands-on API testing experience using Postman.
* Strong expertise in GL reconciliation and financial report validation.
* Ability to analyze complex banking workflows and identify functional and data discrepancies.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Tricentis Tosca automation.
* Experience building reusable automation tools or accelerators for API testing.
* Experience automating report validation and reconciliation checks.
* Exposure to end-to-end banking system integration testing.

title: Data Quality Engineer
description:
**Company:**
Finarb Analytics Consulting Pvt. Ltd.

**Job Title:**
Data Quality Engineer – SQL / ETL / Microsoft Fabric

**Location:**
Hyderabad or Kolkata, India

**Experience:**
3–6 Years (Suggested)

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

About Finarb

Finarb Analytics Consulting is a data, analytics, and technology consulting firm helping organizations transform complex data into actionable business insights through advanced analytics, business intelligence, artificial intelligence, and modern data platforms.

**Website:**
https://www.finarb.ai

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented, technically strong
**Data Quality Engineer**
to ensure the accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability of enterprise data across multiple platforms.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with
**SQL, data validation, ETL testing, data reconciliation, and data quality automation**
, along with a good understanding of data warehousing and modern cloud data platforms.

This role will focus on validating data flowing through SQL Server, Azure Data Factory, and Microsoft Fabric environments, with particular emphasis on ensuring data integrity during platform migration and ongoing production operations.

The successful candidate will collaborate closely with data engineers, BI developers, senior data quality professionals, and data architects to identify data discrepancies, investigate root causes, automate validation processes, and establish reliable data quality controls.

We are looking for engineers who can independently analyze complex datasets, understand transformation logic, and develop scalable, repeatable data quality testing solutions.

Key Responsibilities1. Data Quality Validation and Testing

* Develop and execute comprehensive data quality checks across enterprise data platforms.
* Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, uniqueness, and integrity.
* Perform source-to-target validation across ingestion, staging, transformation, and reporting layers.
* Identify missing records, duplicates, null values, invalid mappings, and inconsistent business calculations.
* Validate data against defined business rules and transformation specifications.
* Investigate discrepancies and collaborate with engineering teams to resolve issues.
* Develop reusable test cases and maintain data quality documentation.

2. SQL-Based Data Testing and Reconciliation

* Develop complex SQL queries to validate data across source and target systems.
* Perform record-count reconciliation, aggregate reconciliation, and detailed field-level comparisons.
* Validate joins, transformations, aggregations, and business calculations.
* Test stored procedures, SQL transformations, views, and data warehouse tables.
* Analyze large datasets to identify inconsistencies and anomalies.
* Investigate root causes of data mismatches and document findings.
* Optimize validation queries for performance and scalability.

3. ETL / ELT Pipeline Testing

* Test data ingestion and transformation pipelines built using Azure Data Factory and Microsoft Fabric.
* Validate pipeline execution results, data transformations, and target data structures.
* Verify incremental loads, full loads, upserts, and change data capture processes.
* Test data handling for missing values, duplicate records, invalid formats, and unexpected source changes.
* Validate pipeline error handling, retry mechanisms, and exception processing.
* Perform regression testing following ETL enhancements and production releases.
* Collaborate with data engineers to investigate and resolve pipeline-related data issues.

4. Microsoft Fabric Migration Validation

* Support data quality assurance during migration from SQL Server and Azure Data Factory to Microsoft Fabric.
* Develop source-to-target reconciliation processes for migrated datasets.
* Validate data transformations across Fabric Lakehouse, Warehouse, and data pipelines.
* Perform row-count, checksum, aggregate, and field-level reconciliation where appropriate.
* Verify historical data completeness and incremental data consistency.
* Identify discrepancies between legacy and Fabric-based processing.
* Support parallel-run validation and post-migration stabilization.
* Maintain migration validation reports and evidence of data quality checks.

5. Data Quality Automation

* Develop reusable SQL-based validation scripts and automated reconciliation processes.
* Build automated data quality checks using Python, SQL, or other appropriate tools.
* Integrate validation processes into ETL/ELT workflows where applicable.
* Automate recurring checks for data completeness, uniqueness, referential integrity, and business rule compliance.
* Implement exception reporting and automated identification of data quality failures.
* Support continuous improvement of testing efficiency and coverage.
* Reduce manual validation effort through repeatable and maintainable testing frameworks.

6. Production Data Quality Monitoring

* Monitor data quality across production data pipelines and reporting datasets.
* Investigate data-related incidents reported by business users or BI teams.
* Perform root cause analysis for recurring data quality defects.
* Track data quality issues and coordinate resolution with engineering teams.
* Validate corrective fixes and perform regression testing.
* Support production release validation and ongoing operational checks.
* Maintain traceability of data quality defects and their resolutions.

7. Collaboration and Documentation

* Work closely with data engineers, Power BI developers, and data architects.
* Understand business rules, data transformations, and reporting requirements.
* Translate data specifications into comprehensive validation scenarios.
* Document test cases, reconciliation logic, test results, and identified defects.
* Participate in requirement reviews, technical discussions, and defect triage.
* Contribute to establishing standardized data quality processes and best practices.

Required Technical Skills

Technology / SkillExpected ProficiencySQL / T-SQLAdvanced querying and validationData Quality TestingAccuracy, completeness, consistency, uniquenessETL / ELT TestingSource-to-target and transformation validationData ReconciliationRecord-level, aggregate, and field-level comparisonsSQL ServerStrong hands-on experienceData WarehousingFact/dimension tables and transformation logicAzure Data FactoryUnderstanding of pipelines and data flowsData Quality AutomationSQL scripts and automated validationDefect InvestigationRoot cause analysis and issue trackingMicrosoft FabricBasic knowledge or practical exposure

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 3–6 years of experience in data quality engineering, ETL testing, data validation, or data warehouse testing.
* Strong hands-on SQL skills, including complex joins, CTEs, aggregations, window functions, and subqueries.
* Proven experience performing source-to-target data validation and reconciliation.
* Experience testing ETL/ELT pipelines and complex data transformations.
* Good understanding of relational databases and data warehousing concepts.
* Experience identifying data discrepancies and independently investigating root causes.
* Familiarity with SQL Server and Azure-based data environments.
* Experience developing and maintaining test cases, validation scripts, and defect reports.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills

* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, and Fabric Data Factory.
* Knowledge of Python or PySpark for automated data validation.
* Familiarity with data quality frameworks such as Great Expectations, Soda, or equivalent tools.
* Experience with Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2.
* Understanding of Delta Lake and medallion architecture.
* Experience validating large-scale cloud data migration projects.
* Familiarity with Power BI reports and semantic model validation.
* Knowledge of Git, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD processes.
* Exposure to data profiling, data observability, and data governance concepts.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Purview or equivalent metadata management tools.

Key Competencies

* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Ability to independently investigate complex data discrepancies.
* Strong understanding of business rules and transformation logic.
* Ability to communicate technical defects clearly and effectively.
* Collaborative approach to working with engineering and BI teams.
* Ownership of testing deliverables and data quality outcomes.
* Ability to manage multiple testing priorities in a dynamic environment.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will be expected to:

1. Ensure high levels of data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across enterprise datasets.
2. Identify and resolve data quality issues before they impact downstream reporting.
3. Develop reusable SQL-based reconciliation and validation processes.
4. Automate recurring data quality checks to improve testing efficiency.
5. Validate data integrity throughout Microsoft Fabric migration activities.
6. Reduce production data discrepancies and recurring data quality defects.
7. Maintain clear documentation and traceability of data quality testing.
8. Contribute to establishing reliable, scalable data quality practices across the organization.

Why Join Finarb?

* Work on enterprise-scale data engineering and analytics initiatives.
* Gain exposure to Microsoft Fabric and modern cloud data platforms.
* Participate in complex data migration and modernization programs.
* Collaborate with experienced data engineers, architects, and BI professionals.
* Develop expertise in data quality automation and advanced data validation.
* Contribute to delivering reliable and trusted enterprise data solutions.

**Capital Market/Treasury Implementation Consultant**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a Capital Markets/Treasury Implementation Consultant (Senior Consultant level) with experience in Capital Markets and Treasury platform implementation, post-trade operations, and technology transformation. The role involves supporting end-to-end delivery of platform implementation and modernization initiatives across trade confirmations, settlements, securities processing, treasury operations, and regulatory reporting. The consultant will work closely with business, operations, risk, and technology stakeholders to design, configure, test, deploy, and stabilize solutions across Capital Markets and Treasury ecosystems.

* Participate in the implementation, enhancement, and modernization of Capital Markets and Treasury platforms.
* Support business and technology workstreams across platform configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and production stabilization activities.
* Collaborate with Front Office, Middle Office, Back Office, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and Technology teams to deliver transformation programs.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into functional and technical solutions.
* Conduct workshops, stakeholder discussions, and gap assessments to identify platform configuration and customization requirements.
* Support trade lifecycle processes including trade capture, confirmations, settlements, reconciliations, accounting, and reporting.
* Assist with system integrations using industry-standard interfaces and messaging protocols.
* Support SIT, UAT, defect management, production validation, and post-implementation activities.

* Knowledge of trade lifecycle processes including trade capture, confirmations, matching, settlements, accounting, reconciliations, and reporting.

* Experience across one or more asset classes including:

+ Foreign Exchange (FX)
+ Fixed Income
+ Equities
+ Money Markets
+ Derivatives (Futures, Swaps, Options)

* 5-8 years of experience implementing, configuring, enhancing, supporting, or integrating Capital Markets and Treasury platforms such as:

+ Murex
+ Calypso/Adenza
+ Kondor+/Fusion Kondor
+ Finastra Fusion
+ SunGard Treasury
+ Broadridge Gloss
+ Fidessa
+ MarkitSERV
+ Summit
+ Or equivalent Treasury and Capital Markets platforms

* Experience supporting large-scale transformation, implementation, or modernization programs.
* Ability to conduct gap analysis between business requirements and standard platform capabilities.

**Technical Skills**

* Working knowledge of Java, Python, PL/SQL, .NET, or similar technologies.
* Experience with Oracle, Sybase, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or equivalent databases.
* Unix/Linux shell scripting experience.
* Understanding of enterprise integration frameworks, APIs, XML, MQ, and messaging technologies.
* Knowledge of financial market connectivity standards including SWIFT MT/MX, FIX, ISO 20022, and settlement interfaces.
* Exposure to DevOps, release management, deployment processes, and environment management.
* Experience supporting system integrations, data reconciliations, and operational issue resolution.

**Functional & Consulting Skills**

* Requirements gathering, business analysis, documentation, and stakeholder management.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to propose scalable, configuration-driven solutions.
* Experience facilitating workshops and engaging with business and technology stakeholders.
* Experience supporting SIT, UAT, defect triage, and production validation.
* Ability to review test cases and collaborate with QA and testing teams.
* Familiarity with Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* Strong communication and client-facing consulting skills.
* Ability to independently manage workstreams and mentor junior consultants.

**Desirable Knowledge**

* Experience with market infrastructure and utility platforms such as SWIFT, DTCC, Omgeo CTM, Traiana, MarkitSERV, or equivalent solutions.
* Knowledge of valuation, pricing, risk management, VaR, P&L, and treasury operations workflows.

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Finance, or a related discipline (BE/BTech/MCA preferred).
* MBA (Finance) or relevant financial markets certification is advantageous.
* 5-8 years of experience in Capital Markets, Treasury Technology, Post-Trade Operations, or Financial Services technology implementation.
* Experience working with banks, broker-dealers, custodians, market infrastructure providers, treasury functions, or financial institutions.
* Proven track record of contributing to Capital Markets or Treasury transformation and implementation programs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Package Consultant-SAP Cloud Integration
description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a Package Consultant specializing in SAP Cloud Integration, you will design, implement, and configure SAP Cloud Integration solutions for clients, focusing on analyzing business requirements and ensuring successful project delivery. You will work closely with clients, project managers, and other team members to understand business needs and develop solutions that meet client requirements.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Design SAP Cloud Integration Solutions: Analyze business requirements and design SAP Cloud Integration solutions to meet client needs, including configuring and implementing SAP Cloud Integration modules such as API Management, Integration Flow, and Cloud Connector.
* Implement and Test Solutions: Configure and implement SAP Cloud Integration solutions, perform unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure solution quality.
* Collaborate with Clients and Team Members: Work closely with clients, project managers, and other team members to ensure successful project delivery and provide training and support to clients on SAP Cloud Integration functionality and best practices.
* Maintain Technical Documentation: Develop and maintain technical documentation, including configuration documents and testing scripts.
* Stay Current with SAP Cloud Integration Releases: Stay up-to-date with SAP Cloud Integration releases, patches, and new features, and apply this knowledge to client projects.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Experience with SAP Cloud Integration: Proven ability to design, implement, and configure SAP Cloud Integration solutions, including analyzing business requirements and ensuring successful project delivery.
* Knowledge of SAP Cloud Integration Modules: Familiarity with configuring and implementing SAP Cloud Integration modules, such as API Management, Integration Flow, and Cloud Connector.
* Experience with Testing and Quality Assurance: Skilled in performing unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure solution quality.
* Certification in SAP Cloud Integration: Possession of certification in SAP Cloud Integration or related areas, demonstrating expertise in SAP Cloud Integration solutions and best practices.
* Experience with SAP System Integration: Knowledge of integrating SAP Cloud Integration with other SAP systems, such as SAP ERP, SAP CRM, and SAP BW.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* SAP Cloud Integration Certification: Possession of certification in SAP Cloud Integration or related areas is beneficial, demonstrating expertise in SAP Cloud Integration solutions and best practices.
* Knowledge of SAP Systems: Familiarity with integrating SAP Cloud Integration with other SAP systems, such as SAP ERP, SAP CRM, and SAP BW, is advantageous.
* Experience with Testing Tools: Exposure to testing tools and methodologies for SAP Cloud Integration solutions is desirable, enhancing the ability to ensure solution quality.

**Team Introduction**
There are 3 products running on premises in Mobile operators’ data centers and in the cloud, with tens of installations all over the world:
  
  
Product 1: Handling mobile calls, forwarding or rejecting, charging them.
  
  
Product 2: Handling mobile data sessions, doing protocol conversion, session correlation, hiding network topology.
  
  
Product 3: Sending notifications to subscribers via SMS, email, push and other protocol, based on incoming requests, remote servers availability.
  
  
All these products are designed for network intensive communication, are based on event driven application server and handle tens of thousands operations per second.
  
  
**What will your job look like?**
As the Non Functional Testing Lead, you will own the quality and reliability of the products under real world telecom workloads. You will design, drive, and evolve the full non functional test strategy across performance, scalability, resilience, stability, and resource efficiency.
  
  
Your Responsibilities
  
  

* Define and Lead NFT Strategy

* Create realistic high load test scenarios for mobile calls, data sessions, and notification delivery workflows.
* Simulate complex operator environments including network latencies, bandwidth constraints, and protocol interactions.
* Identify and Analyze Performance Issues

* Localize issues (high CPU load, memory leaks, locked threads, DB-related, network-related), reproduce them in controlled test setups, and collaborate with developers to resolve them.

* Track KPIs such as throughput, latency, CPU/memory usage, GC performance, DB query performance, and network I/O efficiency.
* Provide tuning recommendations across Java, databases, OS, hardware, and configuration layers.
* Own and Improve NFT Tooling & Automation
* Maintain and optimize the non functional regression suite.

* Enhance observability through metrics, logs, dumps, and monitoring dashboards.
* Cross Team Collaboration
* Work closely with development teams to ensure new features meet performance expectations.
* Support pre production certification with operators and cloud deployments.

**All you need is...**

* Strong expertise in performance engineering, especially in high load, network intensive systems.
* Handson experience with performance tuning and identifying bottlenecks in distributed or telecomgrade systems.
* Solid understanding of the OSI model and practical networking fundamentals.

title: Quality Assurance Specialist | Night Shift (On-site Kolkata)
description:
Company Description

**Comparison Junction**
is a unified comparison and switching platform that helps customers find better-value deals across
**Energy, Telecom, Travel, Insurance, Banking, and other essential services**
.

With over a decade of experience in telesales, digital sales, and inbound customer acquisition, our teams help customers compare available options, understand their choices, and complete their switching journey with confidence.

Role Description

We are looking for a
**Quality Assurance Specialist**
with strong
**Call Centre and Sales Quality experience**
to join our team in
**New Town, Kolkata**
.

The Quality Assurance Specialist will be responsible for
**auditing customer interactions, ensuring compliance with process and client requirements, identifying quality gaps, and providing actionable feedback to improve customer experience and sales performance**
.

This is a hands-on quality role involving
**call auditing, BQ management, compliance checks, RCA, CAPA, reporting, coaching support, and client reporting**
.

The successful candidate should be comfortable working with large volumes of calls, analysing customer interactions, identifying root causes, and converting quality findings into measurable process and performance improvements.

Key Responsibilities
  
☎️ Call Auditing & Quality Monitoring

* Conduct regular
  **call audits**
  based on defined quality parameters, sampling methodology, and audit plans.
* Evaluate customer interactions for:
* Sales effectiveness
* Customer experience
* Communication quality
* Process adherence
* Product/process knowledge
* Objection handling
* Disclosure requirements
* Accuracy of information
* Compliance
* Closing and conversion practices
* Identify critical errors, behavioural gaps, process deviations, and missed sales opportunities.
* Maintain accurate and timely quality scores and audit records.
* Ensure consistency and objectivity in the evaluation process.

💬 Feedback & Coaching

* Provide
  **specific, actionable and timely feedback**
  to Sales Advisors and Team Leaders.
* Identify recurring behavioural and process gaps and recommend targeted coaching interventions.
* Support Team Leaders and Training teams with insights from call audits.
* Conduct calibration sessions to ensure consistent understanding and application of quality standards.
* Track whether corrective coaching results in sustained improvement.

📋 BQ Management

* Own and maintain the
  **BQ (Bad Quality) management process**
  .
* Identify and classify BQ cases based on defined quality and compliance criteria.
* Track BQ trends by
  **agent, team, process, campaign, error type, and root cause**
  .
* Ensure BQ cases are communicated to relevant stakeholders within defined TAT.
* Monitor corrective actions and recurrence of BQ.
* Provide regular BQ analysis to Operations and Management.

🛡️ Compliance & Process Audits

* Conduct compliance checks across customer interactions.
* Ensure advisors follow approved scripts, disclosures, sales processes, and regulatory/client requirements.
* Identify
  **critical compliance breaches**
  and escalate them immediately.
* Monitor adherence to client-specific quality requirements and SOPs.
* Maintain appropriate documentation and audit trails.
* Support internal and client audits when required.

🔎 RCA – Root Cause Analysis

* Conduct
  **Root Cause Analysis (RCA)**
  for recurring quality, compliance, customer experience, and sales issues.
* Identify whether the root cause is related to:
* People
* Process
* Product
* Training
* Technology/System
* Communication
* Policy
* Leadership/management
* Use data and call evidence to validate the identified root cause.
* Distinguish between
  **symptoms and actual root causes**
  .
* Present RCA findings with clear evidence and recommended corrective actions.

🔧 CAPA – Corrective & Preventive Action

* Develop and track
  **CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action)**
  plans arising from quality and compliance findings.
* Define:
* Problem statement
* Root cause
* Corrective action
* Preventive action
* Owner
* Target date
* Success measure
* Track CAPA implementation and effectiveness.
* Conduct follow-up checks to confirm that issues have been permanently addressed.
* Escalate overdue or ineffective CAPAs to the relevant stakeholders.

📊 Reporting & MIS

Prepare and publish regular quality reports covering:

* Quality Score
* Audit Volume
* Pass/Fail Rate
* BQ Trends
* Critical Errors
* Compliance Performance
* Customer Experience Indicators
* Process Deviations
* Agent/Team Performance
* Repeat Errors
* RCA Trends
* CAPA Status
* Improvement Trends

Develop
**daily, weekly and monthly quality dashboards and reports**
for Operations and Management.

🤝 Client Reporting

* Prepare accurate and professional
  **client quality reports**
  .
* Provide quality insights, trends, observations, and corrective-action updates.
* Support client review meetings with relevant quality data.
* Respond to client quality queries and audit observations.
* Ensure client-specific quality and compliance requirements are accurately reflected in internal audits and reporting.
* Coordinate with Operations and Management to close client-identified quality gaps.

📈 Continuous Improvement

* Identify recurring quality issues and recommend process improvements.
* Analyse trends across teams, campaigns, products, and customer journeys.
* Identify opportunities to improve
  **customer experience, sales conversion, compliance, and process efficiency**
  .
* Participate in quality improvement projects and process reviews.
* Recommend changes to scripts, SOPs, training modules, and workflows based on quality insights.

Key Performance Areas

The Quality Assurance Specialist will be measured on:

* **Audit Accuracy & Completion**
* **Quality Score Accuracy**
* **BQ Identification & Reduction**
* **Compliance Adherence**
* **RCA Quality & Timeliness**
* **CAPA Closure & Effectiveness**
* **Repeat Error Reduction**
* **Feedback TAT & Quality**
* **Client Reporting Accuracy & TAT**
* **Quality Reporting & Data Accuracy**
* **Customer Experience Improvement**
* **Process Improvement Contribution**

Qualifications

* **5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Analyst roles within a Call Centre, Contact Centre, BPO, Telesales, or Sales environment.**
* **Mandatory experience in a sales/contact-centre environment.**
* Strong experience in
  **call auditing and quality monitoring**
  .
* Experience handling
  **BQ / Bad Quality management**
  .
* Good understanding of
  **sales processes, customer experience, compliance, and call-centre operations**
  .
* Experience conducting
  **RCA and CAPA**
  .
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong understanding of quality metrics and performance reporting.
* Proficiency in
  **MS Excel / Google Sheets and reporting tools**
  .
* Experience preparing
  **client-facing quality reports**
  is preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
* Comfortable working in a
  **night-shift environment**
  .
* Bachelor's degree preferred.

What We Look For

We are looking for a QA professional who goes beyond
**"checking calls and giving scores."**

The right candidate should be able to connect:
**Call Finding → Customer Impact → Root Cause → Corrective Action → Preventive Action → Measurable Improvement**

You should be comfortable challenging processes, asking
**"Why did this happen?"**
, validating the root cause with evidence, and ensuring that corrective actions actually prevent recurrence.

Strong
**sales understanding**
is particularly important because the role requires evaluating not only compliance and customer experience but also
**sales conversations, objection handling, persuasion, and closing behaviour**
.

Work Details

📍
**Location:**
New Town, Kolkata

💼
**Employment:**
Full-time | On-site

🌙
**Shift:**
**Night Shift / USA Shift**

🕐
**Timing:**
**7:30 PM – 5:00 AM**

📅
**Working:**
5 days a week

**If you have a strong eye for quality, understand sales conversations, and can turn call-level findings into measurable business improvement, we want to hear from you.**

**Senior Finance Test Analyst**
with strong

**80% hands-on testing and quality assurance activities**
with
**20% coordination, communication, and governance responsibilities**
.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Offshore-Onshore Coordination & Communication**

* Act as the primary point of contact between offshore test teams and onshore Test Leads.
* Participate in governance, status, and project meetings.
* Communicate testing priorities and requirements to offshore resources.
* Consolidate offshore progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and blockers.

* Coordinate and track queries between offshore and onshore teams.
* Ensure agreed actions are understood and executed by offshore teams.
* Maintain efficient communication channels and minimize unnecessary escalations.

* Break down testing scope into manageable work packages.
* Monitor progress against milestones and delivery timelines.

* Review requirements and identify required test coverage.
* Develop, review, and maintain test cases and test scripts.
* Support end-to-end business process testing.
* Identify gaps and recommend additional testing where necessary.
* Ensure accurate documentation of testing activities and outcomes.

* Review defects before escalation to ensure completeness and quality.
* Ensure defects contain sufficient detail to support investigation.
* Participate in defect triage sessions and defect review meetings.
* Identify recurring issues and potential root causes.
* Escalate critical defects, risks, and blockers promptly.

* Consolidate and report offshore testing progress.
* Track defects, risks, dependencies, and blockers.
* Participate in daily stand-ups and status meetings.
* Provide visibility into resource utilization and testing capacity.

* Proven experience in functional system testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing support.

* General Ledger (GL)
* Accounts Payable (AP)
* Accounts Receivable (AR)
* Cash Management
* Fixed Assets
* Expenses
* Intercompany
* Tax
* Budgetary Control
* Financial Reporting

**Business Process Knowledge**
**Strong Knowledge Of End-to-end Finance Processes, Including**

* Procure-to-Pay (P2P)
* Record-to-Report (R2R)
* Order-to-Cash (O2C)

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**
This is a critical requirement for the role.

* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Experience working with UK-based or other international stakeholders.
* Ability to explain testing and technical issues to non-technical audiences.
* Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills.
* Ability to consolidate detailed testing information into concise management updates.

 The Conversion SME will own the end\-to\-end data and policy conversion strategy for a Life \& Annuities policy administration system transformation (e.g., legacy platform to FAST/Majesco/OIPA/FINEOS target). This role bridges business, actuarial, and technical teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and auditable migration of in\-force policy data, values, and transaction history from source to target systems.
   

  

 Key Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

**Conversion Strategy \& Governance**
* Define the end\-to\-end conversion approach: crosswalk methodology, data mapping standards, tolerance thresholds, and reconciliation framework between legacy and target platforms.
* Own the conversion playbook — cutover strategy (big\-bang vs. phased/wave\-based), fallback/rollback plans, and freeze\-period governance.
* Establish data lineage documentation and version\-controlled mapping specs for audit and regulatory traceability.


**Business \& Technical Bridge**
* Translate legacy policy administration rules (billing, values, riders, beneficiaries, agent/commission structures) into target system configuration requirements.
* Partner with actuarial, IT, and QA teams to validate converted policy values (cash value, reserves, death benefit, surrender values) against source\-of\-truth calculations.
* Lead root\-cause analysis on conversion breaks/exceptions and drive remediation with configuration or ETL teams.


**Data Mapping \& Rules Definition**
* Author functional specifications for field\-level, transaction\-level, and history conversion (policy, billing, claims\-in\-progress, agent/commission, correspondence).
* Define exception handling rules for non\-standard policies, riders, or legacy product variants that don't map cleanly to the target chart of accounts/product model.
* Validate mapping specs with source system SMEs and target platform configuration leads.


**Testing \& Reconciliation**
* Design and oversee conversion test cycles (mock conversions, parallel runs, dress rehearsals) and define pass/fail acceptance criteria.
* Own policy\-level and aggregate\-level reconciliation reporting (financial tie\-outs, record counts, value tolerances) presented to governance/steering forums.
* Sign off on conversion readiness gates ahead of each cutover wave.


**Team \& Stakeholder Management**
* Lead and mentor a pod of conversion analysts/testers (onshore/offshore); manage workload, quality, and delivery timelines.
* Act as primary conversion point of contact for client business owners, actuarial, compliance, and IT conversion teams.
* Present conversion status, risk, and exception dashboards to steering committee/PMO.


**Compliance \& Risk**
* Ensure conversion approach aligns with regulatory requirements (state filings, policyholder notification rules, NAIC/IFRS 17 where applicable).
* Maintain audit trail documentation sufficient for internal audit and regulatory examination.

**Requirement**

**Data**
 Strong SQL skills; experience with data mapping/ETL concepts; policy value reconciliation (cash value, reserves, COI, fund values for annuities)

 This role sits at the intersection of AI evaluation engineering, Responsible AI, and GenAI security/red teaming. The primary objective is to ensure GenAI/agentic systems are safe, reliable, robust, and fit\-for\-purpose, by designing evaluation strategies, building repeatable test harnesses, and generating auditable evidence that supports go/no\-go decisions.
   

  

 You will work with global stakeholders (product teams, solution architects, risk \& compliance, and assurance leadership) to define evaluation requirements, request test datasets from product teams, execute rigorous evaluations (functional \+ non\-functional), and recommend mitigations and controls to reduce risk.
   

  

 This is a core full\-time role that requires a hands\-on AI Development mindset, strong evaluation mindset, and the ability to translate risk concerns into practical testing strategies and measurable acceptance criteria.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define and operationalize evaluation strategies for GenAI systems across use cases like Q\&A assistants, summarization, extraction, drafting, agentic systems, and multi\-step workflows.
* Translate business use\-cases into a structured evaluation plan: scope, assumptions, success criteria, datasets, metrics, red\-team scenarios, thresholds, and reporting requirements.
* Drive standardization: reusable evaluation templates, test case libraries, scoring rubrics, and reporting formats across product teams.
* Design structured dataset requirements for product teams and ensure coverage across:
+ Core user journeys and primary business intents
+ Edge cases (rare prompts, ambiguous queries, incomplete context)
+ Adversarial cases (malicious prompts, jailbreak attempts, prompt injections)
+ Bias \& fairness cases (sensitive demographic proxies, protected attributes, stereotyping patterns)

* Define guidance for dataset sufficiency and statistical coverage (e.g., minimum samples, distribution balance, scenario matrices, stratification by intent/risk).
* Build reusable evaluation pipelines for:
+ Answer quality (correctness, relevance, completeness, clarity)
+ Grounding \& faithfulness (RAG\-specific: faithfulness, context precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation quality)
+ Agentic behavior (tool\-call accuracy, tool misuse, goal completion, step correctness, unnecessary actions, loop detection, safety of tool outputs)
+ Operational quality (latency, cost/token budget, throughput, stability, retries, failure recovery)

* Combine LLM\-as\-judge and human evaluation in a calibrated way (rubric design, sampling plans, agreement checks).
* Implement automated evaluation harnesses in Python (preferred), enabling:
+ batch runs on scenario suites
+ configurable metric definitions
+ reproducible runs with run IDs and artifacts
+ storage of traces and outputs for auditability

* Execute structured red teaming aligned to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, covering (examples):
+ Prompt injection (direct \+ indirect) and tool hijacking
+ Sensitive data disclosure / PII leakage
+ Insecure output handling (downstream injection)
+ Training data leakage / memorization probes
+ Model denial\-of\-service / denial\-of\-wallet patterns

* Integrate evals into development lifecycle: pre\-release regression gates, CI checks, benchmark comparisons across model versions/prompts/tools/retrievers.
* Perform adversarial testing for agentic workflows:
+ tool misuse / over\-permissioned tool access
+ unauthorized action execution
+ exfiltration via tools/connectors
+ prompt injection via retrieved documents (RAG poisoning)

* Recommend mitigations: input validation, retrieval filtering, tool sandboxing, least\-privilege permissions, guardrails, policy prompting, refusal logic, output encoding, monitoring alerts.
* Produce high\-quality evaluation reports that are auditable and decision\-ready, including:
+ methodology, datasets, metrics, thresholds
+ quantitative results
+ qualitative results
+ risk assessment summary and recommended control actions

* Present findings to stakeholders in a crisp, risk\-informed manner; clearly explain residual risk, limitations, and rationale for go/no\-go.


**Key Requirements/Skills \& Qualification:**
* Excellent academic background, including at a minimum a bachelor’s or a master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Engineering, Operational Research, or other related field with strong focus on modern data architectures, processes, and environments.
* 4–7\+ years of relevant experience in one or more areas:
+ ML/AI/GenAI/Agentic engineering (NLP/LLMs), evaluation engineering, applied research
+ security testing / red teaming
+ building and designing evaluation harness that ensures safety, reliability and robustness.

* Strong hands\-on Python for building evaluation harnesses (data processing, metric computation, orchestration, reporting pipelines).
* Practical understanding of GenAI system architectures: RAG, embeddings/vector search, prompt orchestration, tool calling, multi\-agent systems, memory, routing.
* Experience designing metrics and evaluation methods (rubrics, automated scoring, sampling strategy, regression design).
* Familiarity with LLM risks and mitigations, especially for enterprise contexts (data leakage, hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe content, bias).
* Security / Red Teaming Skills (Strong Preference)
* Understanding of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and how to translate it into test cases and controls.
* Experience with adversarial testing approaches: jailbreak prompts, injection patterns, tool misuse scenarios, retrieval poisoning patterns.
* Familiarity with secure\-by\-design practices for LLM apps: least privilege, safe tool invocation, output encoding/validation, monitoring.
* Evaluation frameworks and tooling: RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, Phoenix/Arize, custom eval harnesses.
* Experimentation practices: A/B testing mindset, baseline comparisons, statistical rigor for sample sizes.
* Observability/tracing: structured logging, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse\-style traces, dashboards.
* Basic DevOps practices: Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker), reproducible environments.
* Strong written communication to produce clear evaluation plans and reports for technical \+ non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to challenge assumptions constructively (“effective challenge”) and influence engineering teams toward remediation.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity with fast\-evolving GenAI tooling and risk landscape.

title: Specialist - Application Security
description:
**Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd \| Business Area: Information Services (IT)**
 Specialist \- Application Security
   

  

**Kolkata, West Bengal, India \| Workplace Type: On\-Site \| Job Type: Regular / Permanent / Unlimited / FTE \| Reference Code: req32550**
 It's about Being What's next. What's in it for you?
   

  

 The Specialist in this position will perform Web, API and mobile application security testing; validate risks and provide actionable remediation guidance.
   

  

 At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on\-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
   

  

 Team
   

  

 Making an impact. What will you do?
   

  

* The Specialist in this position will plan and deliver web, API and mobile VAPT engagements within agreed scope, quality and timelines
* You will perform manual and automated testing; validate findings and eliminate false positives
* And rate vulnerabilities using OWASP, CWE and CVSS, considering exploitability and business impact
* Also, document reproducible evidence, proof\-of\-concept steps and practical remediation actions
* You will need to retest fixes, confirm closure and record residual risk or exceptions
* And maintain test cases, evidence, reports and engagement records in line with VAPT standards
* Lastly, escalate critical findings and delivery blockers promptly; support critical activities outside business hours when required


 Winning in your role. Do you have what it takes?
   

  

* You must have a bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related discipline
* And a CEH or relevant web\-security / scanner certification preferred
* Must have two to four (2–4\) years in application security or an enterprise security team
* And also, at least six months of hands\-on web, API or mobile security testing, including manual testing and scanner validation
* Must is knowledge with OWASP, WSTG, MAS, CWE and CVSS, Web, API and mobile black\-box/grey\-box testing
* You must also know Burp Suite, Qualys WAS/Acunetix, Kali Linux, Nmap and sqlmap, HTTP/S, REST APIs, authentication protocols, mobile controls and network fundamentals


 Why you will love working for us!
   

  

 Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2025 sales of $34 billion. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high\-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain, decarbonize and protect our planet. Linde serves a variety of end markets such as chemicals \& energy, food \& beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, metals and mining. Linde’s industrial gases and technologies are used in countless applications, enabling space exploration and launch technologies, delivering ultra\-high\-purity and specialty gases for semiconductor manufacturing, providing life\-saving medical oxygen and enabling clean hydrogen production and carbon capture to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Linde also delivers state\-of\-the\-art gas processing solutions to support customer growth, efficiency improvements and emissions reductions.
   

  

 Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd. (LGSS) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Linde, based out of Kolkata, India. It is a Global IT Delivery Center that has been successfully delivering IT Enabled Services to the group companies of Linde, across the world for almost two decades, since 2006\. Our goal is to provide and support IT services and solutions that are critical for the operation of the entire group. As part of Linde's core Global IT Team, we cover a wide portfolio of IT services and solutions that ensure the continuous operation of Linde's business across multiple businesses across various geographies, time zones and cultures. The technical teams use their IT skills and experience to maintain and manage the IT applications and infrastructure of the organization.
   

  

 At Linde Global IT Delivery Center, Kolkata we offer exciting career opportunities to grow and work in leading technologies in a truly global work environment.
   

  

 Whatever you seek to accomplish, and wherever you want those accomplishments to take you, a career at Linde provides limitless ways to achieve your potential, while making a positive impact in the world. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
   

  

 For more information about the company and its products and services, please visit linde.com

* Design, develop, and implement comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts for various software components and systems.

* Collaborate with product management, development, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and define testing scope.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing methodologies, processes, and tools.
* Analyze test results, generate reports, and provide insightful feedback to improve product quality and development efficiency.
* Stay up\-to\-date with emerging testing technologies, tools, and industry trends.
* Configure and troubleshoot networking infrastructure, including Layer 2/Layer 3 switches, VLANs, routing, and network security settings, to support integrated software, hardware, and industrial system testing.


**What You’ll Bring \- Job Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 5\- 9 years of progressive experience in software development test engineering, with a strong focus on automation.
* Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Java, C\#, JavaScript) for test automation development.
* Extensive experience with test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, JUnit, TestNG).
* Solid understanding of software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall) and quality assurance principles.
* Experience with various testing types, including functional, non\-functional, API, and UI testing.
* Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with defect tracking systems (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps) and test management tools.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and debugging skills.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and leadership abilities.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced, complex environment.
* Hands\-on experience configuring and troubleshooting network infrastructure, including managed switches, VLANs, TCP/IP networking, routing, and related connectivity technologies in development, test, or production environments.
* Experience with object storage technologies, data lake house architectures, and modern data platforms used to support analytics, machine learning, and AI\-driven solutions.
* Familiarity with AI/ML workflows, data engineering concepts, and validation of data pipelines, models, and AI\-enabled applications.

title: Quality Control Manager
description:
QUALITY CONTROL MANAGER
 



**Industry:** 
 Silica Ramming Mass / Refractory
 



**Location:** 
 Durgapur, West Bengal / Jamshedpur, Jharkhand
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Workplace Type:** 
 On\-site
 



**Experience:** 
 8–10 Years
 



**Relevant Industries:** 
 Refractory, Ceramic, Mineral Processing, Silica/Quartz or Iron \& Steel
 



 Job Responsibilities
 



 • Control and monitor the quality of Silica Ramming Mass from incoming raw materials through to the finished product.
 



 • Inspect and test incoming quartz and silica raw materials for chemical composition, moisture content and relevant physical properties.
 



 • Conduct Particle Size Distribution (PSD), sieve analysis, moisture testing and other relevant refractory quality tests.
 



 • Monitor crushing, screening, grading, blending and mixing processes to ensure adherence to approved specifications.
 



 • Ensure batch\-to\-batch consistency and compliance with established quality standards.
 



 • Maintain quality\-control records, laboratory test reports, Certificates of Analysis (COA) and batch traceability documentation.
 



 • Investigate quality deviations, non\-conformities and customer complaints, and implement appropriate corrective and preventive actions.
 



 • Support customer trials and coordinate with technical and production teams for continuous product and quality improvement.
 



 • Ensure laboratory equipment is properly maintained and calibrated and that testing procedures are followed consistently.
 



 Candidate Profile
 



 • B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Chemistry
 



 • Diploma / Degree in Ceramic Engineering, Refractory Technology, Chemical Engineering, Metallurgy or a related technical discipline.
 



 • 8–10 years of relevant experience in the Refractory, Ceramic, Mineral Processing, Silica/Quartz or Iron \& Steel industry.
 



 Preferred Experience
 



 Candidates with hands\-on experience in
 **Silica Ramming Mass / Induction Furnace Refractories** 
 , along with practical knowledge of
