title: Technical Lead - VIM for SAP
description:
**Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd \| Business Area: Information Services (IT)**
 Technical Lead \- VIM for SAP
   

  

**Kolkata, West Bengal, India \| Workplace Type: On\-Site \| Job Type: Regular / Permanent / Unlimited / FTE \| Reference Code: req32591**
 It's about Being What's next. What's in it for you?
   

  

 The Technical Lead in this position will be responsible for all solution components of the Vendor Invoice Management solution. And contribute to configuration, continuous improvements and standardizations of VIM solutions across SAP systems with the objective to optimize exception, approval and blocked invoice workflows and to increase efficiencies and to maximize the level of automation of the full end\-to\-end process.
   

  

 At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on\-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
   

  

 Team
   

  

 Making an impact. What will you do?
   

  

* The Technical Lead will be responsible for handling the incident \& problem resolution (3rd level support) within defined SLAs and set priorities in close collaboration with Corporate IT and regional IT teams (2nd level support) and with business stakeholders in regions EMEA and APAC Regression testing \& regression test support during major releases and system upgrades
* And support the development of automated tests
* Also, gather and analyze business requirements, translate these requirements into functional and technical scope and functional specifications
* Ans also, design, build and implement improvements and new functional solutions for Vendor Invoice Management processes in SAP based on state\-of\-the\-art SAP standard system capabilities and technical standards, complying with Linde IT standards and IT strategy and fully meeting business requirements
* You will also be required to identify opportunities for process improvements, efficiencies and cost reductions, leveraging S/4Hana capabilities and new VIM functionality
* And coordinate the implementation of new VIM functionality in SAP ECC and S/4Hana Systems according to Linde plc project management guidelines
* You must contribute in knowledge transfer/guidance to and training preparation and delivery for IT and business stakeholders of new IT functionalities and IT solutions
* And collaborate and consult with business and IT teams or stakeholders and manage external service providers to deliver highly dependable, secure, and integrated solutions meeting compliance requirements to the business
* Lastly, cross\-skilling team members to allow growth of team members, distribution of knowledge across team members and a more flexible work allocation.


 Winning in your role. Do you have what it takes?
   

  

* You must have a bachelor's degree in business informatics, Business Administration, or equivalent qualification
* And Global Certification(s) in Vendor Invoice Management for SAP® Solutions, S/4 Hana implementation experience required, ITIL Certification preferred
* A must is also 6\+ years of experience in technical design, implementation and support of international large\-scale systems in Vendor Invoice Management for SAP® Solutions (VIM), at a minimum experience in two end\-to\-end large scale VIM implementations.
* Along with Experience in working with onshore as well as offshore teams
* Knowledge on extensive skills in the implementation and optimization of Vendor Invoice Management for SAP® Solutions (up to most up\-to\-date versions in SAP ECC and S/4Hana) and in the set\-up, administration and optimization of Invoice Capture for SAP
* Must is In\-depth knowledge of SAP and VIM standard functionalities with the aim to minimise programming


 Why you will love working for us!
   

  

 Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2025 sales of $34 billion. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high\-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain, decarbonize and protect our planet. Linde serves a variety of end markets such as chemicals \& energy, food \& beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, metals and mining. Linde’s industrial gases and technologies are used in countless applications, enabling space exploration and launch technologies, delivering ultra\-high\-purity and specialty gases for semiconductor manufacturing, providing life\-saving medical oxygen and enabling clean hydrogen production and carbon capture to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Linde also delivers state\-of\-the\-art gas processing solutions to support customer growth, efficiency improvements and emissions reductions.
   

  

 Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd. (LGSS) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Linde, based out of Kolkata, India. It is a Global IT Delivery Center that has been successfully delivering IT Enabled Services to the group companies of Linde, across the world for almost two decades, since 2006\. Our goal is to provide and support IT services and solutions that are critical for the operation of the entire group. As part of Linde's core Global IT Team, we cover a wide portfolio of IT services and solutions that ensure the continuous operation of Linde's business across multiple businesses across various geographies, time zones and cultures. The technical teams use their IT skills and experience to maintain and manage the IT applications and infrastructure of the organization.
   

  

 At Linde Global IT Delivery Center, Kolkata we offer exciting career opportunities to grow and work in leading technologies in a truly global work environment.
   

  

 Whatever you seek to accomplish, and wherever you want those accomplishments to take you, a career at Linde provides limitless ways to achieve your potential, while making a positive impact in the world. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
   

  

 For more information about the company and its products and services, please visit linde.com
   

  

 Have we inspired you? Let's talk about it!
   

  

 We are looking forward to receiving your complete application (motivation letter, CV, certificates) via our online job market.

title: QA Tester - Website
description:
**Company Description** 




 Envizn Labs is a full\-service digital agency that partners with SaaS and financial services firms to create high\-impact digital experiences that drive measurable growth. The team blends enduring design with strategic creativity to build products and websites that are both visually compelling and highly usable. Messaging and user experience are crafted to earn trust, improve conversion, and support long\-term customer relationships. Joining Envizn Labs means working in a collaborative environment focused on performance, innovation, and tangible results for clients.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 We are looking for a detail\-oriented Website QA Specialist to thoroughly review developed website pages before they are sent to clients or pushed live.
 



 The main responsibility of this role is to compare developed pages with the approved Figma designs and ensure everything has been implemented accurately across desktop, tablet, and mobile. This includes checking layout, spacing, typography, responsiveness, interactions, content, forms, links, animations, and overall website polish.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Review developed website pages against approved Figma designs
* Check desktop, tablet, and mobile responsiveness
* Identify spacing, alignment, typography, color, and layout mismatches
* Check if all sections, components, images, icons, buttons, and CTAs are implemented correctly
* Test links, buttons, menus, forms, popups, sliders, tabs, accordions, and other interactions
* Check hover states, animations, transitions, and scroll behavior
* Review mobile navigation, sticky elements, and responsive spacing
* Check page speed basics, image quality, broken assets, and visual glitches
* Verify content accuracy, typos, line breaks, and missing copy
* Test forms, thank\-you states, error states, and validation messages
* Check browser compatibility across Chrome, Safari, Firefox, and Edge
* Create clear QA reports with screenshots, page links, issue descriptions, and priority levels
* Recheck fixes after developers complete updates
* Maintain a final pre\-launch QA checklist for every website project



  






 Responsibilities
 



* Strong eye for visual detail
* Experience testing websites after development
* Ability to compare live/staging websites with Figma designs
* Good understanding of responsive web design
* Basic knowledge of Webflow, WordPress, Shopify, Framer, or custom websites
* Ability to test across desktop and mobile devices
* Clear written communication for reporting issues
* Familiarity with tools like Figma, ClickUp, Loom, BrowserStack, Google Sheets, or Notion is a plus
* Basic understanding of HTML/CSS is preferred but not mandatory

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AIA – Mainframe Modernization Specialist**
**The opportunity**
 We are seeking a skilled
 **Senior Mainframe Modernization Specialist** 
 to join our
 **AI\-Driven Modernization** 
 practice, focused on transforming
 **legacy mainframe systems** 
 into agile, efficient, and cloud\-ready platforms. The ideal candidate will bring a strong blend of
 **mainframe expertise, AI tools proficiency, and cloud technologies** 
 along with
 **hands\-on collaboration** 
 with cross\-functional teams to deliver scalable modernization outcomes.
   

  

 You will work closely with technology leads, architects, and business stakeholders to analyse legacy applications, leverage AI/ML to automate code analysis and refactoring, and execute migration of mainframe workloads to modern distributed and cloud\-native platforms.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence:**
* Mainframe Systems Analysis and Understanding


* 
+ Assess and analyse existing mainframe applications (COBOL, JCL, VSAM, DB2, CICS, IMS) to identify modernization opportunities and dependencies.
+ Document current\-state architecture, data flows, batch schedules, and integration points across legacy ecosystem components.
+ Perform impact analysis and complexity assessment for potential transitions to modern platforms.
+ AI\-Driven Mainframe Modernization


* 
+ Apply AI tools and custom AI agentic workflows for automated code analysis, refactoring, and technical debt reduction.
+ Develop and fine\-tune AI\-powered assistants to accelerate system conversion and code translation (e.g., COBOL to Java/Python).
+ Apply prompt engineering and context engineering techniques to maximise accuracy and efficiency of LLM\-driven modernization workflows.
+ Modernization Execution


* 
+ Execute modernization tasks including rehosting, refactoring, or rebuilding mainframe workloads based on defined strategies.
+ Participate in the design and implementation of target\-state architectures aligned with cloud\-native and microservices patterns.
+ Ensure code quality, testability, and maintainability throughout the modernization lifecycle.
+ API and Microservices Development


* 
+ Contribute to the design and development of API integrations and microservices to replace or wrap legacy mainframe functionality.
+ Implement RESTful APIs, event\-driven architectures, and integration patterns as part of the target\-state solution.
+ Cloud and Platform Integration


* 
+ Support migration of mainframe workloads to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) using AI\-driven solutions.
+ Integrate modernized components with cloud\-native services, containerised workloads (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.
+ Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code, observability, and security best practices for modernized workloads.
+ Documentation and Reporting


* 
+ Create and maintain technical documentation including system designs, migration runbooks, and AI pipeline configurations.
+ Provide regular status updates on modernization progress, risks, and deliverables to project leads.


**Skills and Attributes:**
**Educational Background**
* B.Tech / B.E. / MCA / M.Tech or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.


**Professional Experience**
* 5 to 9 years of hands\-on experience with legacy mainframe systems (COBOL, JCL, Assembler, CICS, DB2, IMS, VSAM).
* Experience with data migration, integration, ETL processes, and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
* Proficiency in programming/scripting languages such as Python and/or Java.
* Working knowledge of APIs, microservices architecture, and containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Hands\-on experience with AI tools, LLM API calls, prompt engineering, and context engineering for automating code analysis and modernization workflows.
* Experience with mainframe modernization tools or platforms (e.g., Micro Focus, AWS Mainframe Modernization, Azure Migrate) is a plus.


**Soft Skills**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear documentation and presentations.


**Preferred Certifications**
* Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP), AI/ML certifications, or mainframe\-related certifications are a plus.


**Why Join Us**
* Be at the forefront of AI\-driven mainframe modernization across enterprise clients.
* Work with global teams to drive real business impact through digital transformation.
* Collaborate with a team of modernization experts, AI specialists, and technology leaders in a highly innovative environment.


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, serving our clients locally and globally with innovation and at scale.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Specialist - Global Trade System
description:
**Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd \| Business Area: Information Services (IT)**
 Specialist \- Global Trade System
   

  

**Kolkata, West Bengal, India \| Workplace Type: On\-Site \| Job Type: Regular / Permanent / Unlimited / FTE \| Reference Code: req32838**
 It's about Being What's next. What's in it for you?
   

  

 The Specialist in this position will be offering the full scale of global functional SAP Global Trade System services to corporate and regional units around the globe. Also, provide support and define global trade processes, manage embargoes, and offers a solution for Denied Party Screening of Linde’s business partners.
   

  

 At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on\-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
   

  

 Team
   

  

 Making an impact. What will you do?
   

  

* In this role, you will proactive consulting services based on industry practices leveraging previous project experiences in the SAP GTS areas as described (incl. e.g. user authorisations, reports, jobs, table structures, new functionality, system integration/interfaces)
* You will be part of Business projects and enhancements/continuous improvements lik analysis of user requirement received from customer/work effort estimation/create functional specification documenting the solution
* Create the functional solution design which includes SAP standard customizing as well as technical specifications delivered by the development team by using SAP SolMan as Change Management system
* And Perform unit testing, system integration\- \& functional (IT\-) testing
* Supporting customer during user acceptance testing and regression testing. Resolve defects identified during the testing cycles. Support cut over planning/execution and hyper care phase after go\-live
* Conducting workshops and training sessions to gather requirements and provide knowledge transfer
* You will be contributing to Incident Management / Service requests (3rd Level Support) incl. analyzing and resolving the reported issue
* Supporting to perform system upgrades, integrations, and testing


 Winning in your role. Do you have what it takes?
   

  

* Must have at least 3 years of experience in a SAP GTS solution based functional role.
* Academic degree in Business Administration or – Informatics or a certificated IT education min. 4\+ year professional experience in IT processes and ITIL
* Also, practical experience of IT Service Management Processes such as software change and/or release management or application management experience
* You must have the ability to debug SAP code to a certain extent to resolve low level incidents.
* Experience in SAP GTS Edition for Hana with debugging, integration knowledge with other SAP and non\-SAP systems.
* Also, effective communication skills are required to influence stakeholders to achieve support and consistency of the overall IT strategies and policies, specifically in their own subject areas.
* Must have excellent analytical skills, together with the ability to think "outside the box".
* Foreign Trade Zone handling within GTS incl. Material balancing


 Why you will love working for us!
   

  

 Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2025 sales of $34 billion. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high\-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain, decarbonize and protect our planet. Linde serves a variety of end markets such as chemicals \& energy, food \& beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, metals and mining. Linde’s industrial gases and technologies are used in countless applications, enabling space exploration and launch technologies, delivering ultra\-high\-purity and specialty gases for semiconductor manufacturing, providing life\-saving medical oxygen and enabling clean hydrogen production and carbon capture to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Linde also delivers state\-of\-the\-art gas processing solutions to support customer growth, efficiency improvements and emissions reductions.
   

  

 Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd. (LGSS) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Linde, based out of Kolkata, India. It is a Global IT Delivery Center that has been successfully delivering IT Enabled Services to the group companies of Linde, across the world for almost two decades, since 2006\. Our goal is to provide and support IT services and solutions that are critical for the operation of the entire group. As part of Linde's core Global IT Team, we cover a wide portfolio of IT services and solutions that ensure the continuous operation of Linde's business across multiple businesses across various geographies, time zones and cultures. The technical teams use their IT skills and experience to maintain and manage the IT applications and infrastructure of the organization.
   

  

 At Linde Global IT Delivery Center, Kolkata we offer exciting career opportunities to grow and work in leading technologies in a truly global work environment.
   

  

 Whatever you seek to accomplish, and wherever you want those accomplishments to take you, a career at Linde provides limitless ways to achieve your potential, while making a positive impact in the world. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
   

  

 For more information about the company and its products and services, please visit linde.com

title: FS - RC - FSRM - QTB - MRM - AI - SENIOR
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Business Consulting QAS\- Quantitative Trading Book (QTB)**
**Profile: Senior Consultant \- Model Validator \- Generative AI**
**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 This role offers the opportunity to work within EY’s Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group, supporting leading global financial institutions in identifying, measuring, and managing risk including trading‑book market risk \& counterparty credit risk, banking‑book credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory requirements. As part of the Quantitative Trading Book (QTB) team within FSRM, you will contribute to strategic and functional transformation across risk, treasury, and front‑to‑back\-office functions. You will apply quantitative skills to enhance risk and valuation processes, support regulatory compliance, and develop analytics that drive better decision‑making for clients with capital‑markets activities. This is an opportunity for quant professionals looking to work on models, regulatory initiatives, and high‑impact capital‑markets engagements across global banks, broker‑dealers, asset managers, and insurance institutions.
   

  

 EY is seeking a highly skilled Generative AI Specialist with expertise in developing / validating AI models. The successful candidate will be instrumental in driving innovation and enhancing our AI capabilities across various domains.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Demonstrate deep technical capabilities and industry knowledge of financial products
* Lead components of large\-scale client engagements and/or smaller client engagements while consistently delivering quality client services
* Understand market trends and demands in the financial services sector and issues faced by clients by staying abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the client's business
* Manage risk, and effectively communicate with key stakeholders regarding status, issues and key priorities to achieve expected outcomes.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* MRM (SR 11\-7 experience) / Model Audit / Model governance along with Gen AI / Traditional AI
* Deep understanding of various neural network architectures, including convolutional neural networks (CNNs), recurrent neural networks (RNNs), transformers, and generative adversarial networks (GANs), along with their applications in supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning.
* Proficiency in the development / validation of state\-of\-the\-art generative AI models, including RAG structures, as well as experience with natural language processing (NLP) and large language models (LLMs), with skills in data preprocessing, model training, hyperparameter tuning, and evaluation metrics specific to generative tasks for creative content generation and data synthesis.
* Utilize leading AI platforms like OpenAI, Azure GPT, Google Gemini, LLaMA, or Mistral, with proficiency in at least one platform.
* Conduct comprehensive testing and evaluation of AI models on tasks such as text summarization, content generation, and other NLP applications.
* Experience in performance testing of AI models, including evaluation for hallucinations, toxicity, bias, robustness, adversarial attacks, and cybersecurity vulnerabilities.
* Knowledge of responsible AI practices, ensuring fairness, transparency, and accountability in AI model development and deployment.
* Demonstrate ability to learn and apply new concepts, specifically in the area of financial risk management.
* Excellent communication and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to explain complex AI concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.


**Ideally, You Will Also Have**
* Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PySpark and PyTorch. Knowledge in AutoML tools which are used for automating the machine learning pipeline and Auto Kubernetes for managing containerized applications.
* Experience with cloud\-based platforms for building, training, and deploying machine learning models, such as AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, or Google Cloud AI.
* Experience is writing validation reports as per MRM practices.


**What We Look For**
* Undergraduate (4\-year degree) or master’s or Ph.D. in Mathematics, Engineering, Computational Finance, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field with hands\-on experience.
* Relevant certifications in AI/RAI from GARP/ Quantitative courses such as CQF.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and support engagements with global financial institutions
* Willingness to travel based on client needs.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Software Tester
description:
We're a small US software company. We build fast with AI\-assisted development, and we need one exceptional manual tester who finds what the automated tests miss. This is a hands\-on, individual\-contributor role. You will be the first dedicated tester on the team, reporting to the founder.
 



  





**What You Will Do:** 



* Test new features and fixes before they reach customers: end\-to\-end workflows, edge cases, data imports, payments, permissions, and multi\-tenant isolation.
* Write bug reports a developer can reproduce in one read — steps, expected vs. actual, screenshots or video, severity, and what you think the cause is.
* Build and maintain the test checklist for each product area; keep a regression pass that runs before every release.
* Verify data migrations: source records vs. what the system shows, count by count, field by field.
* Communicate proactively. You'll tell the team what you're testing, what you found, and when you'll be online — before anyone asks.
* Push back. If something ships that you flagged, we want to hear about it.



  





**Must Have** 



* 3\+ years of manual / exploratory testing on a production web application, with references who can describe your work.
* Excellent written and spoken English. You will write directly to engineers and occasionally read customer\-reported issues. This is assessed on the call and in your writing sample — please apply only if you're genuinely fluent.
* Experience testing financial software — payments, banking, lending, collections, or billing — where correctness is mandatory.
* Meticulous documentation habits. Show us a bug report you're proud of.
* **Flexibility. There is no set schedule. You'll work around the team's time tables — the founder, the implementation manager, and the engineer are in US time zones — and part of the job is live: reproducing a bug on a call, walking an engineer through what you found, joining a release check before it goes out. Some weeks that means early mornings IST, some weeks late nights. If you need a fixed shift, this isn't the role. What we ask in return is that you communicate — when you're available, when you're not, and what you found — clearly and without being chased.**



  





**Strongly preferred** 



* Time spent in a US debt\-collections or receivables BPO — as an agent, QA, or trainer. You'll understand the users on day one.
* Experience with SFTP file imports, CSV data mapping, or CRM systems.
* Basic SQL to check what's actually in a table.



  





**Compensation:** 
 monthly contractor rate, paid via a global payroll platform, negotiated on experience. A paid one\-week work trial on real test cases precedes any offer.

title: iScala Analyst
description:
iScala ERP Analyst
   

  

 At Johnson Controls, you will join a global organization focused on helping customers improve performance, safety, and efficiency across critical environments. In this role, you will support iScala ERP users and help keep core business processes running smoothly through reliable functional support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 The iScala ERP Analyst will provide day\-to\-day application support across iScala ERP and connected solutions, helping users resolve issues, maintain stable operations, and improve how the system supports business processes. This role is well suited for someone with 4\-6 years of hands\-on experience in ERP support or techno\-functional analysis who enjoys solving problems, working with cross\-functional teams, and supporting end users in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Provide functional support for iScala ERP users and resolve application issues, service requests, and support tickets.
* Support troubleshooting and hyper care activities across iScala ERP and the Edge Apps ecosystem.
* Work with business and technical teams to analyze issues, identify root causes, and coordinate fixes or workarounds.
* Assist with functional deployment across Build, SIT, UAT, and end\-user training activities.
* Support localization, electronic invoicing, advanced functions, and statutory or regulatory compliance needs within the ERP environment.
* Develop and maintain reports, interfaces, and workflow integrations using relevant Epicor and database technologies.
* Document solutions, user guidance, and support outcomes to improve system understanding and future issue resolution.
* Contribute to upgrades, testing, and process improvements that strengthen overall ERP performance.


 How You Will Do It
   

  

* You will take ownership of issues end to end, working with urgency and accuracy to restore service and support business continuity.
* You will stay close to the work by partnering with users, understanding process flows, and removing obstacles before they affect customers or operations.
* You will use structured problem\-solving and root cause analysis to move beyond quick fixes and help prevent repeat issues.
* You will collaborate openly across functional and technical teams, sharing knowledge and contributing to solutions that improve the system for everyone.
* You will look for continuous improvements in support, documentation, testing, and automation so the ERP environment becomes more efficient over time.


**Qualifications**
* 4\-6 years of experience in iScala ERP support, techno\-functional analysis, or a similar ERP application support role.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of iScala ERP and related business processes.
* Experience supporting functional configuration, troubleshooting, deployment, and user issue resolution.
* Working knowledge of MS SQL Server 2019, SQL Programming, SSRS Report Development, and SSIS Development.
* Experience with database management, complex SQL scripting, and investigation of ERP interfaces.
* Familiarity with Epicor Service Connect or similar integration tools is strongly valued.
* Ability to communicate clearly with users and cross\-functional stakeholders in English.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience supporting iScala localization, electronic invoicing, or compliance\-related ERP functions.
* Prior exposure to hyper care support, system upgrades, Build/SIT/UAT cycles, or end\-user training.
* Experience creating user documentation, support guides, or process notes for business users.


 Why Join Us
   

  

 You will be part of a collaborative environment where your work directly supports business users and operational stability. Johnson Controls offers a competitive salary and benefits package, along with opportunities for professional growth and development.
   

  

 If you are ready to bring your iScala ERP experience to a role where your problem\-solving skills can make a real impact, we would love to hear from you.
